rationale: Polypeptides and proteins; amide I/II/III backbone modes dominate.
Mono- and oligosaccharides; C-O-C / C-O-H ring and glycosidic modes.
Free amino acids in zwitterionic form; COO-/NH3+ modes plus side-chain.
Mono/di/triacylglycerols; acyl chain PLUS the ~1745 ester carbonyl and ~1160 C-O-C that separate them from free fatty acids.
Free fatty acids; long acyl chain C-C/CH2 modes, terminal carboxyl.
Fused-ring sterols and steroids; ring-breathing and methyl modes.
Small organic acids of central metabolism; carboxylate modes.
Phospholipids and sphingolipids; phosphate head group plus acyl chain.
Glycosidically polymerised sugars; distinguished from monosaccharides by glycosidic-linkage modes, and given a separate class because V6 found a distinct polysaccharide_glycosidic motif.
Purine ring systems; ring-breathing near 720-730 cm-1.
Conjugated pigments (carotenoid polyene, flavin, porphyrin); strong resonance-enhanced conjugated-chain modes.
Thiol / thioether / CoA-type cofactors; C-S and S-H modes.
DNA/RNA polymers; backbone phosphate plus base modes.
Phosphorylated small molecules and inorganic phosphate; symmetric PO stretch near 980 cm-1.
Pyrimidine ring systems; ring modes near 780-800 cm-1.
